name: Agent Plan
goal: Deliver a self-hosted Claude Code plugin (marketplace, no approval) bundling @agent-plan/mcp + a /planner skill + a non-blocking SessionStart hook, with a reusable multi-plugin folder structure ready for Codex and future harnesses.
description: Self-improvement: add harness-specific plugin bundles (Claude Code first, Codex next) alongside the existing npm packages, so Agent Plan integrates natively with multiple coding-agent harnesses.
decisions: D1: plugins live in a top-level plugins/ dir, separate from packages/ (static bundles, not npm packages).
D2: one subdirectory per harness (claude-code/, codex/); _shared/ holds single-source-of-truth templates.
D3: planner logic stays in @agent-plan/mcp (npm); plugins reference it via .mcp.json (npx -y @agent-plan/mcp).
D4: planner disabled by default at startup; web dashboard does NOT auto-start (respects user constraint).
D5: /planner load enables planner + starts web (LAN) + emits recap with Web UI address; /planner stop disables.
D6: Web UI address shown only on /planner load recap or /planner web status (not every message — Claude Code has no message_end hook to append to final message).
D7: SessionStart hook is non-blocking notification only (no auto-start, no recap injection).
D8: distribution via self-hosted marketplace (channel 2, no approval); official directory (channel 3) optional future.
D9: planner operations (handoff, CRUD) are NOT code edits and allowed regardless of task state.
D10: entity references use composite IDs F00x/P00x/T00x, never raw UUIDs.
globalRules: For recurring UI patterns, prefer shared reusable components over route-local reimplementations; if you create a toggle, accordion, disclosure, or similar primitive, reuse it consistently instead of duplicating markup and styles in each screen.
